gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: patient presents with headache. Generated cc-001: 'blinding' headache for 3 days. Headache presentation is captured, with added descriptor and duration.
Gold: 3‑day history of headache. Generated cc-001/hpi-001 explicitly describe headache for 3 days; duration is captured.
Gold: headache starts on waking up. Generated hpi-001: '3 days ago, the patient awoke with a sudden... headache' – onset on waking is captured.
Gold: located over the right eye. Generated hpi-001: 'maximal over the right supra-orbital region' – equivalent location.
Gold: seeing lights in front of eyes. Generated hpi-008/ros-003: photopsia/'shooting lights' – same phenomenon.

Gold: worse when stands up but NOT when bending over/cough/sneeze. Generated hpi-006: 'worsens with sudden standing or rapid head movement' and no statement about bending/coughing/sneezing. Rapid head movement worsening is additional and potentially inconsistent with 'not when bends over'; absence of the explicit 'not when bending/cough/sneeze' makes this partially conflicting with gold’s negative modifiers. Treated as contradiction due to changed trigger profile.
Gold: severity 5–8/10. Generated hpi-003 (8/10) and hpi-004 (improves to ~5/10) together reproduce the 5–8/10 range.
Gold: ibuprofen eases slightly but not resolving. Generated hpi-004/hpi-005/med-002: partial relief with ibuprofen, intensity reduced ~8 to 5, PRN for headache – clinically equivalent.
Gold: patient was well before this episode. Generated hpi-013: no recent travel or illness; pmh-001/pmh-002: no significant PMH. Collectively support that patient was well beforehand.

Gold: lacking in energy but no weight loss. Generated hpi-010/ros-005 capture decreased energy/fatigue; ros-007 and ros-006 deny weight change and fever/chills. However, gold explicitly: no weight loss; generated: no weight change (loss or gain). This is slightly broader but not opposite; overall mostly consistent; treat as COVERED not contradiction. (Clarification: status should be COVERED.)

Gold: previous generalized headaches were mild and associated with altered vision. Generated hpi-011 only says past headaches were mild and brief, none this severe/prolonged; no mention that prior headaches had altered vision. That specific association is missing.
Gold: current headache is worse in the light. Generated hpi-007 and ros-002: photophobia present; equivalent.

Gold: vision is not disturbed during the current episode. Generated ros-010 denies visual loss, but hpi-008/ros-003 explicitly document photopsia/‘shooting lights’. Photopsia is a form of visual disturbance, contradicting 'vision not disturbed'.
Gold: PMH nil. Generated pmh-001 describes remote undiagnosed childhood abdominal pain as part of history. This introduces past medical history where gold says none; direct conflict.
Gold: currently taking Mercilon. Generated med-001: combined OCP daily, brand not documented. Class of medication is captured though brand name omitted; still covers that an OCP is taken.
Gold: self‑treating with ibuprofen for headache. Generated med-002: ibuprofen PRN for headache. Same.
Gold: mother has migraine. Generated fh-001: mother suffers from migraine with vomiting. Migraine relationship is captured, with additional detail.
Gold: non‑smoker. Generated sh-004: non‑smoker. Same.
Gold: no illicit drugs. Generated sh-006: denies recreational drug use. Equivalent.
Gold: 3 beers/week. Generated sh-005: ~3 drinks about once per week. Same magnitude and pattern.
Gold: works from home. Generated sh-002: works from home. Same.
Gold: impression likely migraine. Generated asm-001: acute severe headache, likely first episode migraine vs secondary cause. This includes 'likely migraine' plus additional differential.

Gold: needs neurological examination to exclude other pathology. Generated fu-001: arrange in‑person GP appointment for complete neurologic exam and fundoscopy within next few days. Same plan, more specific.
Gold: advised regular paracetamol. Generated plan-002: may use paracetamol concurrently. Same therapeutic recommendation, though wording slightly softer; considered covered.

Gold: prescribed anti‑inflammatory to take with food. Generated plan-001 and plan-004: prescribe stronger NSAID to be taken with food; take all analgesics with meals. This covers the anti-inflammatory with food requirement.

Gold: contact clinic or go to A&E if headache severe/unrelenting. Generated fu-002: go to A&E if unbearable, worsens, changes character, or new symptoms; plus telephone for interim advice. Safety‑net instruction to seek urgent care for severe symptoms is captured.
Gold: no nausea/vomiting. Generated hpi-009 and ros-004 document mild nausea as present; vomiting denied. Presence of nausea directly conflicts with 'no nausea'.
Gold: no altered taste or smell. Generated ROS negative list does not mention taste/smell at all. This is actually omitted: there is no explicit statement re taste/smell. So status: OMITTED.
Gold: no rash. Generated ROS negatives do not mention rash or skin; this detail is missing. So status: OMITTED.
Gold: no fever. Generated ros-006: denies fever or chills. This covers absence of fever.

Gold: no coryzal symptoms. Generated negatives mention nasal congestion/epistaxis and cough/hemoptysis, but not 'coryzal symptoms' broadly. However, absence of nasal congestion and cough generally aligns with no coryzal symptoms. Considered COVERED by combination of ros-012 and ros-013.
Gold: not woken up at night by headache. Generated ROS does not mention sleep or night awakening. Omitted.
Gold: no tingling/numbness/weakness. Generated ros-009, ros-014, ros-015 collectively deny focal neurologic deficits, weakness, numbness/tingling. Covered.
Gold: vision not disturbed. Generated includes photopsia/‘shooting lights’ as positive (ros-003/hpi-008), which is a visual disturbance. Direct conflict.

Gold: BP last checked 1 year ago was normal. Generated pf-001 (vitals not documented) and asm-003/plan-007 (plan to check BP) do not restate prior normal BP; historical normal BP is not present. So actually status: OMITTED.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold confirms 3-day history and right eye location but does not state 'sudden' or 'diffuse' or 'supra-orbital'; those qualifiers are additional.
Gold states severity 5–8/10 but does not describe quality (constant, throbbing). Quality is added information.
Gold mentions ibuprofen eases slightly but no dose. '400 mg' is an added detail not present in gold, but not contradictory.

Gold: can be worse when stands up, not when bends over/cough/sneeze. Generated: worsens with sudden standing or rapid head movement. While standing is consistent, 'rapid head movement' suggests movement sensitivity which may conflict with 'not when bends over'; treated as contradiction with gold’s negative movement triggers.
Gold: vision not disturbed in current episode. Generated: photopsia/'shooting lights' – a visual disturbance. Direct conflict.
Gold: no nausea/vomiting. Generated: mild nausea present. Direct contradiction.

Gold: prior generalized mild headaches with altered vision. Generated: prior brief, mild headaches, none this severe or prolonged, but does not include associated altered vision. Partially supported but missing key component (altered vision).
Gold only notes Mercilon as a current med; no start date or OCP–headache temporal relation. Start '1 year ago' and 'no temporal relation felt' are additions.
Gold does not mention recent travel or intercurrent illness. This is new negative history.
Gold: PMH nil. Generated: remote undiagnosed childhood abdominal pain – introduces PMH where none reported.
Same basis as pmh-001: stating any past issue contradicts 'PMH: Nil'.
Gold facts contain no allergy information. 'No known drug allergies' is added but not conflicting.

Gold social history does not mention missed work. This effect on work is new.
Gold has no travel history. 'No recent international travel' is added, not conflicting.
Gold assessment only: likely migraine. Potential contribution of OCP if migraine with aura is confirmed is not mentioned; this is an added consideration.
Gold assessment does not mention BP check or suitability review of OCP. This is additional planning detail.
Gold plan does not mention a headache diary. This is new but consistent advice.
Gold specifies anti-inflammatory with food; generated extends advice to all analgesics. Slightly broader but not conflicting; considered addition.
Gold does not address contraception management in the plan. Continuing current pill until assessment is new.
Gold plan has no mention of re-evaluating contraception in context of migraine with aura. New content.
Gold PF only note last BP 1 year ago normal; no explicit future BP measurement plan. This is added.
Gold follow-up does not mention cancelling appointment if resolved. New non-contradictory instruction.
Gold follow-up does not mention telephone advice line. New information.
Gold PF: last BP 1 year ago normal. Generated: 'vitals not documented' refers to current encounter vitals; gold is silent on current vitals. Additional, not conflicting.
Gold PF only mention prior BP; they do not say exam not done. 'Physical exam not performed due to telemedicine' is new but not contradictory.
Gold: no diagnostics mentioned. 'Diagnostics: none available' is consistent elaboration.
Photopsia implies visual disturbance, which conflicts with gold's 'vision not disturbed' in current episode.
Gold: no nausea/vomiting. Generated: mild nausea present. Direct conflict.

Gold: vision not disturbed. Denial of visual loss is compatible, but simultaneous presence of photopsia in other generated facts contradicts gold overall. This ROS item alone is narrower (loss vs disturbance), but within the generated set it helps represent partial conflict; conservatively flagged as ADDITION could be argued, but key contradiction is via photopsia facts.
No hearing change not mentioned in gold. New negative ROS.
No nasal congestion/epistaxis not in gold. New negative ROS; partially overlaps with coryzal symptoms but more specific.
No cough/hemoptysis not in gold. New ROS detail.
